quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Superstars are the top tier of the NBA, like LeBron and Steph
quotes.excerpt: The superstars is the top. The top of the top. That is the LeBron James, the Stephen Curry.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Superstar status fluctuates based on performance and age
quotes.excerpt: You don't always be a superstar. You fluctuate. Your game is at an all-time high, you're a superstar.
quotes.quote: You don't always be a superstar. You fluctuate. If your game is at an all-time high, then you're a superstar. And then as you get older, your game goes down. You're not a superstar no more.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Superstars are global icons who transcend the sport
quotes.excerpt: A superstar is a prominent high-earning figure with massive current popularity and peak performance within their field.
quotes.quote: A superstar is a prominent high-earning figure with massive current popularity and peak performance within their specific field. While global icons transcend their immediate industry and era, representing a deeper cultural impact. That is the LeBron James, the Stephen Curry, the Giannis Antetokounmpo, the Luka Doncic, the Kevin Durant.
